NEIGHBORS ACROSS AMERICA

Where should we look?

5-mile radius

Five miles means straight-line distance. ZIP searches start at an approximate ZIP center. Address lookup uses the U.S. Census Geocoder; directory searches send coordinates or ZIP to Feed America. This app does not save your search location.

SEARCH THE NATIONAL DIRECTORY

Food assistance nearby

i

Know before you go

National search requests current directory records from Feed America (feedam.org, EIN 92-1761881), an independent publisher distinct from Feeding America. Records include their original source label and publisher-reported verification date. Many listings are not independently verified by us. Call to confirm hours, eligibility, and availability.

Only food pantries, food banks, mobile pantries, soup kitchens, and community fridges are included. SNAP retailers and health centers are excluded. Some food banks serve partner agencies rather than individuals. The source can return a limited subset; displayed records are sorted by approximate straight-line distance, not route length.

Data attribution: Feed America, feedam.org, EIN 92-1761881. CC BY 4.0 / terms. Saved listings stay in this browser. Data is fetched when you search; inventory is not live. Address coordinates are approximate, based on Census address ranges.

NEED ANOTHER OPTION?

There’s more help out there.

Open another directory’s own search or speak to someone about local assistance. External directories use their own filters and distances; their records are not imported here.
